work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent XCVII heading 72859, synopsis 72861–72865 and own papal self-protocol 72867–72868. Ordered exordium, petition and dispensation for Portuguese chapters continue through the executory mandate and concluding clauses 72870–73113, including the source's §4-to-§6 numbering. Historical provenance 72883 and variants 72885, 72935, 72937, 73046, 73098 remain included. Full dating 73115–73117 and short dating 73119 close it before XCVIIl heading 73122. Source full dating prints 'die  xix  decembi-is' and 'MDcxLVii'; date remains null without normalization.
